instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Instruction alone does not give live-bundle owner, TrustManager rebuild rules, or ticket gate; solver must engage Go/Java code and mesh-notes.

discovery_budget.discovery: Live trust bundle epoch is owned by fold_a publish into /app/data/state/live-bundle.json; copying CA PEM alone (fold_legacy) leaves issuance on the pre-cutover root.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the live-bundle owner collapses diagnose into a CA-file checklist.

discovery_budget.discovery: Java sieve_b must rebuild TrustManager from the live bundle and enforce intermediate not-after; a cached TrustManager (tm-cache.json) accepts expired intermediates until SPI rebind.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating TrustManager rebuild + not-after enforcement turns the task into recipe transcription.

discovery_budget.discovery: Resumed handshakes reuse ticket_epoch; emit_c must reject when ticket_epoch is below live epoch even if leaf material looks fine; readycheck only curls /ready.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Telling solvers tickets must be invalidated removes the discoverability tax on session reuse.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Reports readiness OK, fresh-vs-reuse divergence, expired-intermediate accepts; omits algorithms, order, and fix loci.

attack_path.summary: Read mesh-notes and runtime epoch → publish live bundle via fold_a → rebuild TrustManager/SPI via sieve_b → gate resumed tickets via emit_c → meshctl probe.
attack_path.reasoning: Wrong order or decoy CA-only path leaves readycheck green while probe cases fail.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Oracle patches fold_a, sieve_b, and emit_c bodies (≥30 LOC substantive) then runs meshctl probe.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Three-module cutover completion; not golden JSON rewrite.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Distributed across Go/Java roots, opaque symbols, false-green readycheck, no answer fixtures.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Solver must recover issuance × TrustManager cache × ticket reuse under dual roots from runtime truth.
